name: Non-text Content
requirement: Provide text alternatives for non-text content
exceptions: Decorative images that convey no information can be marked so assistive technology ignores them.

name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
requirement: Provide alternatives for prerecorded audio/video

name: Captions (Prerecorded)
requirement: Provide captions for prerecorded audio in video
exceptions: Does not apply to media that is itself an alternative to text and is clearly labeled as such.

name: Audio Description or Media Alternative
requirement: Provide audio description or text alternative

name: Captions (Live)
requirement: Provide captions for live audio in video

name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
requirement: Provide audio description for prerecorded video

name: Sign Language (Prerecorded)
requirement: Provide sign language interpretation

name: Extended Audio Description
requirement: Provide extended audio description when needed

name: Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
requirement: Provide text alternative for prerecorded media

name: Audio-only (Live)
requirement: Provide alternative for live audio content

name: Info and Relationships
requirement: Preserve structure and relationships in code

name: Meaningful Sequence
requirement: Maintain correct reading sequence in code

name: Sensory Characteristics
requirement: Don't rely solely on shape, size, location, or sound

name: Orientation
requirement: Don't restrict content to single display orientation
exceptions: Does not apply where a specific orientation is essential (e.g. a piano app).

name: Identify Input Purpose
requirement: Identify the purpose of input fields

name: Identify Purpose
requirement: Identify the purpose of UI components

name: Use of Color
requirement: Don't use color as only visual means of conveying info

name: Audio Control
requirement: Provide mechanism to pause/stop audio over 3 seconds

name: Contrast (Minimum)
requirement: Text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
exceptions: Does not apply to decorative text, logos, or text in an inactive UI component.

name: Resize Text
requirement: Text resizable up to 200% without loss of function

name: Images of Text
requirement: Use text instead of images of text when possible
exceptions: Does not apply to logotypes or when a specific presentation is essential.

name: Contrast (Enhanced)
requirement: Text contrast ratio of at least 7:1

name: Low or No Background Audio
requirement: Speech recordings have minimal background noise

name: Visual Presentation
requirement: Text formatting options for readability

name: Images of Text (No Exception)
requirement: Images of text only for decoration or essential

name: Reflow
requirement: Content reflows without horizontal scrolling at 400%

name: Non-text Contrast
requirement: UI components have 3:1 contrast ratio

name: Text Spacing
requirement: No loss of content with adjusted text spacing

name: Content on Hover or Focus
requirement: Dismissable, hoverable, persistent content

name: Keyboard
requirement: All functionality available via keyboard
exceptions: Does not apply to activities requiring input that depends on the path of user movement (e.g. free-hand drawing).

name: No Keyboard Trap
requirement: Keyboard focus can move away from components

name: Keyboard (No Exception)
requirement: All functionality available via keyboard

name: Character Key Shortcuts
requirement: Shortcuts using only letters can be turned off

name: Timing Adjustable
requirement: Time limits can be extended or turned off
exceptions: Does not apply to real-time events or essential time limits (e.g. an auction).

name: Pause, Stop, Hide
requirement: Moving content can be paused, stopped, or hidden

name: No Timing
requirement: Timing not essential part of activity

name: Interruptions
requirement: Interruptions can be postponed or suppressed

name: Re-authenticating
requirement: Data preserved after re-authentication

name: Timeouts
requirement: Users warned about data loss from inactivity

name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
requirement: No content flashes more than 3 times per second

name: Three Flashes
requirement: No content flashes more than 3 times per second

name: Animation from Interactions
requirement: Motion animation can be disabled

name: Bypass Blocks
requirement: Mechanism to bypass repeated content blocks

name: Page Titled
requirement: Pages have descriptive titles

name: Focus Order
requirement: Focus order preserves meaning and operability

name: Link Purpose (In Context)
requirement: Link purpose determinable from link or context

name: Multiple Ways
requirement: Multiple ways to locate pages within a site
exceptions: Does not apply to a single step in a process.

name: Headings and Labels
requirement: Headings and labels describe topic or purpose

name: Focus Visible
requirement: Keyboard focus indicator is visible

name: Location
requirement: Information about user's location in site

name: Link Purpose (Link Only)
requirement: Link purpose determinable from link text alone

name: Section Headings
requirement: Section headings used to organize content

name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
requirement: Focused component not entirely hidden

name: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
requirement: Focused component not partially hidden

name: Focus Appearance
requirement: Focus indicators meet size and contrast requirements

name: Pointer Gestures
requirement: Multi-point gestures have single-point alternatives

name: Pointer Cancellation
requirement: Down-event not used to trigger functions

name: Label in Name
requirement: Visible label included in accessible name

name: Motion Actuation
requirement: Motion-triggered functions have alternatives

name: Target Size (Enhanced)
requirement: Touch targets at least 44x44 CSS pixels

name: Concurrent Input Mechanisms
requirement: Don't restrict input to single modality

name: Dragging Movements
requirement: Dragging has single-pointer alternatives

name: Target Size (Minimum)
requirement: Touch targets at least 24x24 CSS pixels
exceptions: Does not apply to inline links in text, or when the target size is determined by the browser and not modified.

name: Language of Page
requirement: Default language can be programmatically determined

name: Language of Parts
requirement: Language of passages can be programmatically determined

name: Unusual Words
requirement: Mechanism for definitions of unusual words

name: Abbreviations
requirement: Mechanism for expansions of abbreviations

name: Reading Level
requirement: Supplemental content for complex text

name: Pronunciation
requirement: Mechanism for pronunciation of ambiguous words

name: On Focus
requirement: No context change on focus

name: On Input
requirement: No context change on input without warning

name: Consistent Navigation
requirement: Navigation appears in consistent order

name: Consistent Identification
requirement: Same functions identified consistently

name: Change on Request
requirement: Context changes only on user request

name: Consistent Help
requirement: Help mechanisms appear in consistent location

name: Error Identification
requirement: Errors automatically detected and described

name: Labels or Instructions
requirement: Labels or instructions provided for input

name: Error Suggestion
requirement: Suggestions for fixing errors when known

name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
requirement: Submissions reversible, checked, or confirmed

name: Help
requirement: Context-sensitive help available

name: Error Prevention (All)
requirement: All submissions reversible, checked, or confirmed

name: Redundant Entry
requirement: Auto-populate previously entered information
exceptions: Does not apply when re-entry is essential (e.g. security fields).

name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
requirement: No cognitive function test for authentication
exceptions: Object recognition and identification of non-text content submitted by the user are permitted.

name: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
requirement: No object or user-supplied content recognition

name: Name, Role, Value
requirement: Name, role, value available for all UI components

name: Status Messages
requirement: Status messages announced to assistive technologies
